notes: POC objective: validate Dedicated can meet sustained throughput and tail-latency SLOs for realtime chat + rerank workloads and drive reserved GPU sizing for Q3 production commit.

Primary workloads: customer support chat (fast responses, 1–4 turns, avg response 180 tokens), reranking of search results (batch <= 64 docs, embedding + cross-attention rerank), and short summarization for agent notes.

Traffic profile: baseline 600 concurrent active chats during business peak, expected to spike to 1800 during incident windows. Average message length ~ 120 tokens, reply length ~ 180 tokens. Rerank jobs: 40 qps average, 200 qps burst for 10s windows.
Initial capacity ask: reserve 8 x A100-80GB (or equivalent) with headroom to burst + autoscale 2x for short windows. Redwood estimate matched to ~700k reqs/day tokenized workload.
POC tests agreed (deliverables):
- Load tests: step-up from baseline to peak (600 -> 1800 concurrent chats) over 90 minutes; measure throughput, p50/p95/p99 latency for generation and model inference time per token.
- Soak tests: 72-hour sustained baseline traffic at 650 concurrent chats to validate memory/KV cache behavior and GPU thermal/allocator stability.
- Spike tests: synthetic bursts of 3x baseline lasting 30s–2min to verify autoscale/fallback behavior and queueing tail-latency.
- Tail-latency profiling: capture p99.9 and distribution under mixed workload (chat + rerank) and identify preemption events.
- Throughput guarantees validation: measure aggregate tokens/sec and derive per-GPU effective tokens/sec to inform reserved GPU planning.
Representative prompts (samples included in Drive):
- "Support chat: 'My shipment was delayed, tracking shows in transit — help me escalate and refund'"
- "KB search + rerank: user query -> top 100 candidate passages -> rerank 64 in-batch scoring"
- "Summarize last 5 agent messages into a 3-sentence case note"
Acceptance criteria (to sign Dedicated):
- p95 generation latency for typical chat reply (<= 250ms) at baseline load; p95 <= 400ms at peak load with graceful degradation.
- p99 for rerank requests (batch 64) <= 800ms.
- No OOM or model OOM events during 72-hour soak; <0.1% request errors.
- Autoscale ramp time <= 60s for validated burst, or documented fallback policy that keeps p95 < 500ms.
- Clear SLA language on credits for missed monthly availability/latency SLOs; legal requested model for credits.
Operational and architecture notes:
- Will run private VPC peering + dedicated capacity in us-west-2. KMS keys to be provisioned by SummitForge security team. Need Redwood docs for KMS key rotation and HSM support.
- Plan to enable prefix KV caching for repeated greetings and session state to reduce decode cost by ~18% in lab runs.
- Model family preference: open-weights medium-large (quantized 4-bit candidate) for cost/perf tradeoff; fallback to smaller 7B for severe capacity constraints.
- Compilation kernels: request Redwood to capture effective kernels/throughput numbers for the model variants used so we can compare to internal benching.
